_about: Synthetic recording of the verification of p-cart-app-warn-timeout-calling-inventory-65c2-drop (`make fixtures-synth`, server/server/verify_synth.py): Grail answers for the volume and reference queries and the Dynatrace MCP execute_dql answer for new Davis problems. The MCP result format is not documented; this uses a JSON text block. Replace with real recordings once a tenant exists.

volume.query:
fetch logs, from: -60m
| filter service.name == "cart" and log.source == "app" and loglevel == "WARN" and matchesPhrase(content, "Timeout calling inventory")
| summarize before = countIf(timestamp < now() - 30m),
    after = countIf(timestamp >= now() - 30m)

problems.query:
fetch dt.davis.problems, from: -30m
| filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate)
| filter event.start >= now() - 30m
| fields display_id, event.name, event.status, event.category, event.start
